# Pregnancy announcement maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pregnancy-announcement/

Create a downloadable announcement card using your own words and dates. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Create a portrait announcement with a family name, headline and optional estimated arrival month.

## Limits and checks

The card uses the text you provide and makes no medical claims. Check names and dates before sharing the exported image.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
